top_signals.title: AMD dives on short-seller report of alleged China exposure
top_signals.summary: AMD was slumping after a short-seller alleged that its firmware showed up at a blacklisted Chinese company. The company said it complies with U.S. law.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Musk accuses Zelenskyy of lying about Starshield restrictions in Ukraine
top_signals.summary: Elon Musk was asked about Zelenskyy claims over the Starshield network, and he said, "I don't want to blow your mind, but Zelenskyy is not always truthful."

top_signals.title: Blue Owl Plans $513 Million CMBS for Amazon-Leased Data Center
top_signals.summary: Blue Owl Capital Inc. is preparing to sell $513 million of commercial mortgage backed securities to fund the acquisition of a Northern Virginia data center that’s fully leased to Amazon.com Inc., according to people with knowledge of the matter.
